name: 王立邦
objective: 永續發展是妥善規劃與管理自然資源之最高指導原則，因此本課程依此宗旨討論空氣污染防制與管理、環境永續規劃與管理、礦物資源等；更將以實際例將面向擴及科技與社經整合層次，以期落實理論於實際應用之中。

第 1~6 週: 礦物資源
第 7~11 週: 空氣污染防制與管理

name: 胡憲倫
objective:
學生將會學習從較宏觀的視野來認識屬於人文與社會層面的環境管理。課程將會透過系統思考及永續創新的角度，來反思地球的現在與未來；闡述新經濟時代的來臨與綠色資本主義的重要性及其四種策略，來緩解氣候變遷及全球暖化的趨勢，創造企業競爭優勢，並開創人類永續發展的新契機。
Students will be guided from a broader and global perspective to learn the social and human aspects of protecting the Earth. Lectures will cover systems thinking and its importance to Sustainable Development. Innovative and emerging technologies for sustainability and "net zero" emissions will be explored. Natural Capitalism and its strategies, Circular Economy, and the Bottom (Base) of the Pyramid (BoP) theory will also be taught to help strive for a sustainable future.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1 導論 - 資本主義與永續發展 (綠色資本主義/永續發展目標)
             Introduction- Capitalism and Sustainable Development/Natural Capitalism and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
Week 2 系統思考與系統化管理 (Systems Thinking and Environmental & Sustainable Systems Management)
Week 3 永續創新及生物模擬－師法自然 Sustainable Innovation and Learning from Nature- Biomimicry
Week 4 服務與流動的經濟 (產品服務系統) 及循環經濟 Product Service System (PSS)& Circular Economy
Week 5 金字塔底層及包容性經濟 Bottom of the Pyramid (BOP) & Inclusive Business
Week 6 結語及分組報告 (Conclusion and Group Presentation)

name: 鄭婉婷
objective:
Part 3: From Dec. 3rd to Jan. 7th
Through a Project-based Learning approach, students will be guided to apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) throughout the process of problem identification, literature exploration, methodology development, result analysis, and solution proposal in the field of environmental management and planning. Students will conduct an individual/group project throughout the course and complete a final project report.

透過專題導向學習（Project-based Learning），學生將學習如何在環境管理與規劃領域中應用人工智慧（AI），涵蓋問題辨識、文獻探索、研究方法建立、結果分析及解決方案提出等過程。學生將於課程期間持續完成個人/團隊專案，並於課程結束時提交完整專案報告。
課程進度(1-16週):
Part 3: From Dec. 3rd to Jan. 7th

Week 13: Application of AI in Identifying Urgent Social and Environmental Issues
第 13 週：應用 AI 辨識社會與環境之重要議題

Explore and analyze current environmental issues through AI.
Identify project problems, objectives, and approaches.
Conduct group discussions and report project progress.

透過 AI 探索與分析當前環境問題。
確立專案問題、目標及研究方向。
進行團隊討論並報告專案進度。

Week 14: Application of AI in Literature Exploration, Integration, and Analysis
第 14 週：應用 AI 進行文獻探索、整合與分析

Apply AI tools for searching, summarizing, and analyzing scientific literature.
Develop theoretical foundations and identify research gaps.

應用 AI 工具進行科學文獻搜尋、整理與分析。
建立理論基礎並辨識研究缺口。

Week 15: Application of AI in Research Methodology Development
第 15 週：應用 AI 於研究方法之建立與發展

Use AI to support the selection of appropriate methodologies for projects.
Develop research methods, implementation plans, and data collection / analysis approaches.

運用 AI 協助選擇適合專案之研究方法。
建立研究方法、執行計畫及資料蒐集與分析方式。

Week 16: Application of AI in Result Analysis, Solution Development, and Recommendations
第 16 週：應用 AI 進行結果分析、解決方案建立與建議提出

Apply AI for data analysis and project result evaluation.
Develop environmental management solutions and recommendations.

應用 AI 進行資料分析與專案成果評估。
建立環境管理方案並提出改善建議。

Week 17: Group Peer Review and Solution Improvement
第 17 週：團隊反饋與專案方案完善

Conduct round-table discussions among groups.
Review, evaluate, and improve environmental problem-solving strategies proposed by each group.

進行各團隊間之圓桌討論。
針對各組提出之環境問題解決方案進行反饋、評估與改善。

Week 18: Application of AI in Project Report Completion and Responsible AI Use
第六週：應用 AI 完成專案報告與負責任 AI 使用

Discuss important considerations when applying AI in research and project implementation.
Apply AI to support the completion of final project reports.
Final quiz on the application of AI in environmental management and planning.

說明 AI 應用於研究與專案執行時的重要注意事項。
應用 AI 協助完成期末專案報告。
進行「AI 於環境管理與規劃之應用」相關之期末測驗。
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          During the two weeks of flexible online learning, students will collaborate in groups to integrate the knowledge and skills acquired throughout the course. Each group will discuss, refine, and complete their AI-assisted environmental management project, followed by the preparation and submission of a final project report.  在兩週彈性網路學習期間，學生將以分組合作方式整合課程所學之知識與技能。各組將進行 AI 輔助環境管理專題之討論、修正與完善，並完成期末專案報告之撰寫與提交。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          After completing the two-week flexible online learning, students will be able to:

  Collaborate in groups to integrate course knowledge into an AI-assisted environmental project. 
 Refine project outcomes through online discussion and peer feedback. 
 Complete and present a final project report demonstrating the application of AI in environmental management.

完成兩週彈性網路學習後，學生將能夠：

 透過團隊合作整合課程知識，完成 AI 輔助環境專案。 
 藉由線上討論與同儕回饋改善專案成果。 
 完成並呈現展現 AI 應用於環境管理之期末專案報告。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Group project final report (20%) Evaluate teamwork, project completion, and the application of AI in environmental management.

materials:
本課程未指定外文原文教科書，教材內容由授課教師依據相關研究文獻與實務案例彙整設計。

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
